surfaces.name: Toast
surfaces.summary: Single slot, 3000ms, last writer wins with no queue. Used by every module (~100 call sites).

surfaces.name: Chart LUT SVG filters

Applied as a filter on the base tile container only when base is bluetint, via the CSS vars --chart-lut/--chart-trim (data-lume day/dusk/night). Nothing sets data-lume today.

safetyCritical: Fetch deadline wrapper: every fetch without its own signal aborts at 30s (or timeoutMs) with Error('timed out after Ns'). It must be installed before any module fetches (app.js:19-41). The timer stops at response headers, so body reads are unbounded.

Boot never bricks: the migration flag is written before the non-awaited tile sweep (app.js:55-61); readJSON deletes corrupt keys (643-648); a stale base falls back to 'ocean' (200-203); gpsStart, bootDone and SW registration run in finally even after an init error (585-637).

anchorRestore (app.js:540) sits inside the single try and is skipped if any earlier init step throws, so the watch is silently lost after a reload. The port should run it (and GPS start) as independent guarded steps.

SW update deferral: never reload during Goto.active, Tracks.recording, Nav.anchor.watching or Voice.on/_wantOn. Defer, never discard; apply on visibilityâ†’visible and on goto/track/voice stop (app.js:600-636). anchorRaise does NOT call applyPendingUpdate. Motor.armed is not in the busy list; a reload fires pagehide â†’ motorStop (motor.js:575), so pagehide must keep working.

Follow/refollow: a drag turns follow off and arms a 45s refollow; only non-programmatic zooms arm it (GPS._programmaticMove, 800ms window via mapProgrammatic); an explicit â—‰ OFF is never auto-reverted (app.js:338-362).

Chart LUT direction: deep is pale and shallow is saturated; the night LUT inverts luminance but keeps shallow brightest. Never use CSS invert(). Copy the feColorMatrix, gamma and table values byte for byte (index.html:40-80). The SVG must live in the same document, not display:none, and no <base href> may be introduced.

The CSS filter goes only on the Leaflet tile container, never on #map or an ancestor of fixed UI. filter/transform on an ancestor would break all position:fixed elements, including the anchor alarm overlay (app.js:167-170).
No fade-in on layers (a stalled animation would leave a blank chart, app.js:107-110). The sheet animation is transform-only, never opacity or translate (style.css:190-206).
Panel height clamp against the measured #topbar bottom + 8, min 160px, re-run on resize and orientationchange (+250ms), so the âœ• can't be trapped under the iPhone status bar (app.js:292-314).

Emergency: formatCoord rounds before splitting (never 60.000'). Exact SMS body/URL 'sms:<number>?body=' with 5-dp decimals and a Google Maps link. Copy falls back to a toast. There is no fix-age warning on the emergency position (flag, don't silently change). prompt cancel aborts. All emergency static copy (satellite SOS steps, VHF 16, 911, MAYDAY script, PAN-PAN) verbatim.
Module veto on overlay toggles: app.js reads e.target.checked AFTER sstEnable/rainEnable, so the offline uncheck persists false; at boot offline the pref stays true (app.js:254-270).
Relief bases (gmrt/bluetint) force ENC on, including at every boot (app.js:155-159, 204-208). ENC blend is multiply only on gmrt (code disagrees with the comment) â€” preserve the code.
Motor buttons must stay synchronous user-gesture handlers (Web Bluetooth transient activation); arming is only ever reachable by a deliberate tap (app.js:544-559).

SW: the CRITICAL set is filtered to SHELL so a typo can't brick install; the rest are allowSettled with one retry; cache:'reload'; non-GET never cached; cross-origin not intercepted; offline navigation falls back to ./index.html (sw.js).
APP_BUILD must equal the CACHE suffix; navigator.serviceWorker.startMessages() is required or the version reply never arrives (app.js:399-402).
Wake lock and keep-alive status text must report actual state (gps.js:225-241, awake.js); React must not render optimistic 'On' text.

Honesty copy that must survive verbatim: the iPhone screen-lock/GPS hint (index.html:174-178), the anchor alarm hint (341), the motor interlock disclaimer and 'foot pedal and the real remote are the only true kill' (380-384), and the API key 'stored only on this device' (273).
risks: React must keep every panel, modal and banner mounted (hidden via class). Legacy modules call getElementById(...).classList/innerHTML on hidden panels and would throw on null.

Containers filled by legacy modules (spots-list, catch-list, motor-log, wx-current, etc.) must be rendered by React with no children, or reconciliation will throw removeChild errors after innerHTML replacement.

Legacy modules toggle classes on #btn-follow, #btn-voice, #btn-track, banners, #btn-anchor, nav tool buttons and the motor arm button. A React className re-render would wipe them unless the engine state owns those classes.
React 18 StrictMode double-invokes effects; a second L.map('map') throws 'Map container is already initialized'. Boot must be guarded to run once, and #map must never unmount.

Synthetic dispatchEvent('change') on React-controlled checkboxes does not fire React onChange. assistant.js:1349, weather.js:105-106, sst.js:44, rain.js:19 and reefs.js:154-156 must be rewired to an engine setDataOverlay action.
download.js derives its layers from DOM radios and checkboxes; it must be rewired to engine layer state while reproducing its exact (bluetint-excluding) list.
openDB has no onblocked handler: a blocked upgrade hangs the boot forever (splash stuck, no GPS, no SW). An openDB rejection leaves the app with no map at all.

Long-press to mark depends on Leaflet tapHold, which needs 'safari' in the UA. iOS standalone and a stock WKWebView UA may lack it, so long-press would do nothing. Verify on device (fix via the shell's applicationNameForUserAgent or tapHold:true, as a deliberate flagged change).

Native fishapp:// shell: no service worker (no updates, label stays 'build v93'); prompt/confirm need WKUIDelegate or they return null/false (the emergency contact can't be set, deletes silently refuse); sms:/tel: need navigation delegate handling; storage is separate from the GitHub Pages origin.

Vite build: must keep base './' (GitHub Pages /fishapp/ and the custom scheme). sw.js SHELL/CRITICAL must be generated from hashed assets, and CACHE/APP_BUILD derived from one injected version, bumped every release.
The toast is last-writer-wins; boot toasts clobber each other (the hands-free resume notice is overwritten by the anchor restore notice). Adding a queue changes behaviour â€” flag it.
Reefs race: reefsInit().then applies the boot-time reefPrefs, overriding a toggle made before the data loads; reefs.js âžœ ticks the box without persisting.

The README claims the ENC-off choice persists on relief bases, but the code re-forces ENC on every boot. The ENC blend comment says multiply for both relief bases but the code only does it for gmrt. Owner decisions are needed; the port should keep the code behaviour.
No back/escape handling exists. Introducing router history would change Android back behaviour; Escape-to-close would be a new feature.
The fetch timeout clears at response headers, so slow body reads are unbounded; a stricter port would change behaviour.
sw.js has no notificationclick handler, so tapping an anchor/GPS alarm notification won't focus the app.
weather.js showAreaForecast opens the weather panel without togglePanel (no tab highlight, no clamp). A unified React openPanel state would change this, benignly.
